Red Bull Racing: Red Bull has reshaped the front of the car – the side‑pod inlets and the surrounding bodywork – to smooth the air that reaches the floor and rear, while also tweaking the engine cover to match the new shape. Scuderia Ferrari: Ferrari’s latest tweaks see the front‑brake ducts narrowed at their inner exit and the shape of the front‑floor fairing tweaked. The smaller duct smooths the airflow over the car, helping the front end stay more stable, while the new floor profile improves overall downforce without adding drag. Together they should give the drivers a tighter, more predictable feel through the corners this weekend.
